entry.title: Economizing attention: Markets and barter in video advertising platforms
entry.summary: This article examines how video advertising platforms reconfigure attention as a commodifiable resource, drawing on political economy and platform studies to analyze the market dynamics of attention in digital advertising ecosystems.

entry.title: Remaking the landscape of scientific expertise: The emergent research program of total automation in science

author.name: David Peterson, Bernard Koch, Ramya Natarajan

entry.summary: This article traces the emergence of 'total automation in science' as a research program, examining how automated systems are reshaping scientific expertise, practice, and epistemic authority across disciplines.

entry.title: AI fear of missing out (AI FOMO): Desire without action under social pressure
entry.summary: This article introduces the concept of 'AI FOMO' — the fear of missing out on AI-related opportunities — and explores how social pressure generates desire without corresponding action in the adoption of artificial intelligence technologies.

entry.title: Fair synthetic data is not about fairness
entry.summary: This article critically examines the notion of 'fair synthetic data,' arguing that the technical approaches to fairness in synthetic data generation often obscure deeper structural inequities and fail to address the socio-political dimensions of data fairness.
